description: `cli org member --help` prints the nested group topic and exits 0 (not an unknown-command error).

stdout.text:
Usage: prose [GLOBAL OPTIONS] cli org member <COMMAND> [ARGUMENTS] [OPTIONS]

Commands:
  list                        List an organization's members, numbered by when they joined; account ids are not shown.
  remove                      Remove a member.
  role                        Change a member's role.

Examples:
  prose cli org member list acme-research --json
  prose cli org member remove acme-research MEMBER --yes
  prose cli org member role acme-research MEMBER developer --yes

Global options:
  --output human|json|jsonl   Output mode; the same as the PROSE_OUTPUT setting.

Run `prose cli org member <COMMAND> --help` for details. `prose cli service operations --json` prints every command as JSON.
